rules.rationale: Base equation for the recursively defined allInts domain predicate on the empty ValSeq.
Constructor recurrence defining allInts by the head sort predicate and the recursively checked tail.
Alias equation defining the named proof predicate definedProjectInt to be the existing isInt sort predicate.

Adds an unproved simplification fact characterizing the definedness of K's existing partial Val-to-Int cast; Stage 1 compiles this rule before proving the target and contains no prior exact proof of it.
Guarded defining equation for the new named proof term projectIntTotal, identifying it with the partial Val-to-Int cast on its defined domain.
Symbolic reverse orientation of the same guarded defining equality for the named projectIntTotal proof term.
Static-sort defining case stating that projectIntTotal is the identity on an Int argument.
Idempotence is an additional reusable simplification fact about projectIntTotal, not a constructor case; it is present during all Stage 1 proofs and is never first proved without itself.
Trusted widened-sort simplification for applyBin addition under isInt guards; although Stage 1 calls it derived, prove.sh never proves this exact rule against a definition that omits it.
Trusted widened-sort simplification for applyBin multiplication under isInt guards; it is compiled into the proof definition before kprove and has no separate rule-free proof.
Base equation defining the sumFrom left-fold summary on the empty ValSeq.
Structural recurrence defining sumFrom by adding the projected head to the accumulator and descending on the tail.
Base equation defining the productFrom left-fold summary on the empty ValSeq.
Structural recurrence defining productFrom by multiplying the accumulator by the projected head and descending on the tail.
